MFA makes it harder for someone else to sign in because they need another way to verify it\u2019s you, even if they know your password.
What are the benefits of MFA?
Open your security settings to enable or disable the verification methods available for your account.

We use multiple safeguards to help protect your information and account\u2014including encryption, expert security testing, and monitoring for suspicious activity.

We don't share your conversations with advertisers or marketing partners, and we never sell your data to anyone.
Learn how data is shared when you connect ChatGPT to your favorite tools.

By default, ChatGPT will ask you for permission before important actions like sending a message or sharing sensitive data. It can read information from connected apps without asking. You can change these default setting anytime. <learnMore>Learn more</learnMore>
Will ChatGPT ask for approval before using an app?
A plugin brings together what ChatGPT needs to complete a task, and can contain one or more apps or skills. Apps can connect ChatGPT to external tools, services, or information.
What\u2019s the difference between a plugin and an app?
Disconnecting an app stops ChatGPT from accessing the app and its data. It doesn\u2019t delete data from apps that may be in past chats or related saved memories, which you can delete separately.
What happens if I disconnect an app?

<paragraph>When you connect an app, it may receive relevant details from your conversation and memory to help provide context for your requests. If memory is enabled, data from the app may also be used to proactively provide helpful information or suggestions.</paragraph><paragraph>Data shared with apps is handled according to each app\u2019s terms of service and privacy policies, which you can see before enabling the app.</paragraph><paragraph>ChatGPT always respects your training data preferences, including for data from connected apps.</paragraph><paragraph>You can manage your preferences or disconnect from apps anytime in your settings.</paragraph> <learnMore>Learn more</learnMore>

What\u2019s included in a data export?

Deleting your account is permanent and can\u2019t be undone. You\u2019ll lose access to OpenAI services, and your data will be deleted within 30 days, except for limited data we may keep longer when required or permitted by law.
What happens if I delete my account?

Yes. You can delete individual chats or all your chats without deleting your account. Deleted chats are removed from your history right away and scheduled for permanent deletion within 30 days, subject to limited exceptions.
Can I delete chats without deleting my account?
Request an export in Data Controls or through the Privacy Portal. You\u2019ll receive a download link by email or text when it\u2019s ready. Exports can take up to seven days.
How do I export my data?
Clear answers about privacy. Simple ways to stay in control.
Learn more about how ChatGPT uses location information.

ChatGPT may estimate your general location from your IP address, such as your city or state, to improve results and help protect your account. If you turn on Location Services, ChatGPT can also use your precise location for local results, like nearby places, weather, or news.
When does ChatGPT use location information?

<paragraph>You can enable precise location by turning on Location Services in Settings > Data Controls. The scope of this permission may vary by device (for example, you may choose to allow ChatGPT to access your precise location only while you are using the app).</paragraph><paragraph>You can turn Location Services off anytime. If you turn it off, ChatGPT won't use your precise location. It may still estimate your general area from your IP address, or you can type a location instead.</paragraph>
How do I turn precise location on or off?

Your precise location is only used if you choose to share it. When Location Services are on, ChatGPT may share precise location information with trusted providers to answer local requests, like finding nearby businesses or checking the weather.
Does ChatGPT share my precise location?

ChatGPT does not separately save or store your precise location outside of what information is included in your ChatGPT conversation and context. Information included in ChatGPT's response, such as nearby places, will remain in your chat history until you delete it.
Does ChatGPT save my precise location?
Protect chats with your PIN, face, or fingerprint.

Lock a chat to keep its title and content out of view in your regular sidebar, history, and search results. You\u2019ll need your PIN or your device\u2019s unlock method, such as Face ID or fingerprint, to open it.

Locked chats can use what ChatGPT remembers from both regular and locked chats. After you lock a chat, new messages can personalize other locked chats, but not regular chats. Locking a chat doesn\u2019t remove information ChatGPT may already remember.
How does memory work with locked chats?
Yes. It stays locked until you choose to make it a regular chat.
Will a chat stay locked after you open it?
ChatGPT can remember helpful details between chats, so your answers become more personalized over time.
Your memories are private to your ChatGPT account. They aren't visible to others.

Type what you want changed into the text box at the bottom of the memory summary and it will update accordingly. You can highlight any text in the memory summary to make a specific correction. To fully delete something ChatGPT may know about you, delete every source where it appears \u2014 including past chats, archived chats, files, the memory summary \u2014 and disconnect any connected apps that may contain that information.
What if I don\u2019t want ChatGPT to remember something about me?

When enabled, memory helps ChatGPT automatically remember useful context from your chats, files, and connected apps to personalize your experience, so you don\u2019t have to repeat yourself as often. If you don\u2019t want to reference or update memory, use <temporaryChat>Temporary Chat</temporaryChat>.

When enabled, memory helps ChatGPT automatically remember useful context from your chats, files, and connected apps to personalize your experience, so you don\u2019t have to repeat yourself as often. If you don\u2019t want a chat to use or update memory, start a <temporaryChat>Temporary Chat</temporaryChat> and choose Unpersonalized.
You can always ask ChatGPT what it remembers about you, or review your <memorySummary>memory summary</memorySummary>.
How can I see what ChatGPT remembers about me?
Choose whether your chats help improve OpenAI's future models.
Choose whether your chats help improve OpenAI's models.

Your future chats won't be used to improve OpenAI's models. Turning this setting off doesn't delete your chats, affect your chat history, or change your memory settings. Alternatively, if you don\u2019t want ChatGPT to remember something you\u2019ve asked, you can use a temporary chat.
What happens if I turn model improvement off?
If you choose, your conversations with ChatGPT can help improve OpenAI's models, making ChatGPT more accurate and helpful for everyone.

We work to identify and remove personally identifiable information from your conversation data when you allow us to use it for training. We also take steps to make sure that models don't surface personal information of private individuals.
Is my personal information used to improve models?
Choose whether the ads you see are personalized using your data.
Personalized ads use information from your chats, interactions, and preferences to make the ads you see more relevant.
No. Ads never influence ChatGPT's responses, and advertisers can't access your chats, chat history, memories, or personal details.

You can turn personalized ads on or off anytime. If you turn them off, you'll still see ads based on your current chat and basic information like your general location or device type. You can also delete your advertising data. To chat without using memory for ad personalization, use Temporary Chat.
How do I manage personalized ads?
Start a conversation that isn't saved to your chat history or memory.
Use temporary chats when you don't want a conversation saved to your chat history or memory. Temporary chats also aren't used to improve OpenAI's models.
Temporary chats stay out of your history unless you choose to save them. While temporary, they don\u2019t create or update memories, and they aren\u2019t used to improve OpenAI\u2019s models.

<paragraph>Temporary chats aren't saved and don't create memories unless you choose to save them to your chat history.</paragraph><paragraph>Locked chats are saved, protected by an Account PIN, and create memories separate from your general memory.</paragraph>
Temporary chats aren't saved to your chat history. Locked chats let you save a conversation while keeping them out of view.
How are temporary chats different from locked chats?
When starting a new temporary chat, choose Personalized to apply your default settings for memories, plugins, and custom instructions, or Unpersonalized to use none.
How can I choose whether a temporary chat is personalized?
That temporary chat becomes a regular chat in your history and follows your account-level personalization settings and model-improvement preferences.
What happens if I save a temporary chat?
